# HAYKALAH

> HAYKALAH (هيكلة) is a Saudi-born structuring house operating from Riyadh and Jeddah since 2004. It designs, implements, operates and monitors what it structures. Descriptor: Strategic architects of Value.

HAYKALAH works with five client groups: family offices and trusts; founders and private investors; sovereign and government entities; banks and financial institutions; and international companies entering the Kingdom.

Six practices:
- Real estate structuring and execution: raw land to income-generating assets, through SPVs, capital stacks and fund vehicles.
- Family offices and sovereign partners: governance, succession and multi-jurisdictional continuity.
- Strategic financial and capital structuring: Sukuk, M&A, JVs, securitization and off-balance-sheet vehicles, under FINA.
- Venture building and execution: HAYKALAH as institutional co-founder, from validation to capital readiness.
- Digital transformation: AI reporting dashboards, ERP and CRM automation, investment-platform architecture.
- Turning expenses into revenue: activate under-used assets, structure and operate them, and share in the revenue.

The record (all figures indicative):
- 650+ engagements, 2004–2026, across 22 years and three market cycles.
- 13 sectors, none above 17% of the record.
- 16 countries on four continents: countries where HAYKALAH has worked on, studied or proposed engagements.
- SAR 31.2bn plus USD 5.2bn of client projects on HAYKALAH's 2011 register. Project value is the size of the client project as recorded, not capital raised by HAYKALAH.
- About 35 live mandates and ventures.
- A deep Holy Cities franchise: two decades of work inside the economy of Makkah and Madinah. Clients are described, not named, until they consent in writing.

Sub-brands: FINA. financial structuring · MARK. market impact · AXIS. access · AGTI. AI precision farming.

Company: HAYKALAH Financial Advisory · Commercial Registration No. 7014123751, Riyadh and Jeddah, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Website: https://www.haykalah.com/. Email: haykalah@haykalah.com. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/Haykalah

Important: Information only. Nothing on the HAYKALAH website is an offer, a solicitation or investment advice. Shariah structures are subject to Shariah board approval. Regulated activities are executed through appropriately licensed partners.

## How HAYKALAH creates value

Six ways HAYKALAH creates value for its clients. They describe what HAYKALAH does for clients; they are not the four eras (Accumulate, Commercialize, Monetize, Utilize) in which HAYKALAH built its own know-how. Regulated activities are executed through appropriately licensed partners.

- Innovation: We design the structure a deal needs, even when no template exists.
- Monetization: We turn assets that cost money to hold into recurring income and capital.
- Optimization: We test every option before capital is committed, then choose the best use, cost and control.
- Automation: We automate reporting, records and routine operations, so people spend their time on judgment.
- Transformation: We change how an organization, an asset or a portfolio works, from governance to data.
- Commercialization: We take ideas, knowledge and public assets to market with a business model, an operator and paying users.

Each one in full: https://www.haykalah.com/en/approach.html#six-ways

### Practices
- [Real Estate Structuring and Land Development in Saudi Arabia](https://www.haykalah.com/en/expertise/real-estate-structuring.html): HAYKALAH structures Saudi land and buildings into income-producing assets: feasibility, capital stacks, SPVs and fund vehicles, then delivery.
- [Family Office Structuring and Governance in Saudi Arabia](https://www.haykalah.com/en/expertise/family-offices-sovereign-partners.html): HAYKALAH structures how families and sovereign entities hold, govern and pass on their assets: holding companies, boards, waqfs and the vehicles beneath.
- [Sukuk and Capital Structuring in Saudi Arabia (FINA.)](https://www.haykalah.com/en/expertise/financial-capital-structuring.html): FINA. is HAYKALAH’s financial structuring practice: Sukuk, funds, JVs, securitization and bank facilities, with Shariah board approval and licensed partners.
- [Venture Builder in Saudi Arabia: Institutional Co-Founder](https://www.haykalah.com/en/expertise/venture-building.html): HAYKALAH co-founds ventures as an institutional partner: validation, company setup, platform, go-to-market and capital readiness, with equity vesting at gates.
- [AI Dashboards and Digital Transformation](https://www.haykalah.com/en/expertise/digital-transformation.html): HAYKALAH builds the data layer behind structured assets and companies: AI reporting dashboards, ERP and CRM automation, data rooms and investment platforms.
- [Asset Monetization in Saudi Arabia: Idle Land to Income](https://www.haykalah.com/en/expertise/turning-expenses-into-revenue.html): HAYKALAH’s asset-monetization engine turns idle land, buildings and facilities into recurring income: audit, optimize, structure, operate, monetize.

### Client groups

- [Market Entry and JVs in Saudi Arabia](https://www.haykalah.com/en/clients/international-companies.html): HAYKALAH helps international companies enter Saudi Arabia through joint ventures, localization structures and Saudi entities it co-founds and helps grow.

### Insights and tools
Structure explainers, the Structuring Brief and three tools. Everything here is general information, not an offer, a solicitation or investment advice. The tools ask for no personal details. Ask HAYKALAH is in Beta: until its AI assistant is connected it shows the most relevant passages from HAYKALAH's published pages, with sources.

- [Insights: Explainers, Tools and the Brief](https://www.haykalah.com/en/insights.html): Structure explainers, the monthly Structuring Brief, tools to find your starting point, and the Saudi Structuring & Sukuk Review 2026, now in preparation.
- [Structure Finder: Find Your Starting Point](https://www.haykalah.com/en/finder.html): Two questions, who you are and what you need, and the Structure Finder shows the practice, structures and cases that fit. A starting point, not advice.
- [Asset Readiness Check: Five Questions](https://www.haykalah.com/en/readiness-check.html): Five questions, one for each step of HAYKALAH’s asset-monetization engine, show where an idle or under-used asset would start. Not advice, not a valuation.
- [Ask HAYKALAH (Beta): Answers from Our Pages](https://www.haykalah.com/en/ask.html): Ask about Sukuk, structures or HAYKALAH’s work. Answers are generated only from our published pages and show numbered sources. Beta. Not investment advice.
- [Stadium Sukuk (Proposal): How It Would Work](https://www.haykalah.com/en/explainers/stadium-sukuk.html): A proposal with no mandate: how a stadium could be financed through Sukuk, with Musataha rights over the land, Istisna’a for construction and an Ijara lease.
- [The Asset-Monetization Engine, Step by Step](https://www.haykalah.com/en/explainers/asset-monetization-engine.html): How HAYKALAH’s engine takes idle land, buildings and facilities from a cost to recurring income: audit, optimize, structure, operate, then monetize and recycle.
- [Sukuk al-Ijara: How Lease-Based Sukuk Work](https://www.haykalah.com/en/explainers/sukuk-al-ijara.html): Sukuk al-Ijara step by step: the originator, the SPV, the transfer of the asset, the lease, rent paid to the Sukuk holders and the repurchase at maturity.

## Knowledge Center

Plain definitions, in English and Arabic, of the Sukuk, Islamic contracts, vehicles and methods HAYKALAH works with, from Ijara to equity-for-build. General information, not legal, Shariah or investment advice.

### Islamic finance instruments
- [Sukuk](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/sukuk.html): Sukuk are Shariah-compliant certificates that represent an undivided share in an underlying asset, project or business activity, or in its returns.
- [Ijara](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/ijara.html): Ijara is a Shariah-compliant lease in which the owner of an asset lets another party use it for an agreed term in return for an agreed rent.
- [Istisna’a](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/istisnaa.html): Istisna’a is a Shariah-compliant contract to manufacture or build a specified asset for an agreed price, with delivery at a future date.
- [Murabaha](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/murabaha.html): Murabaha is a Shariah-compliant sale in which the seller discloses what an asset cost and sells it at that cost plus an agreed profit, often with payment deferred.
- [Musharaka](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/musharaka.html): Musharaka is a Shariah-compliant partnership in which two or more parties contribute capital to a venture, share its profit as agreed and bear its losses in proportion to their capital.
- [Wakala](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/wakala.html): Wakala is a Shariah-compliant agency contract in which one party, the principal, appoints another, the agent or wakil, to act on its behalf, usually for an agreed fee.

### Vehicles and structures
- [JV SPV](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/jv-spv.html): A JV SPV is a company that two or more partners form for a single project or asset, so that the project’s ownership, finance and risk sit apart from the partners’ other businesses.
- [DevCo / ProjectCo](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/devco-projectco.html): A DevCo/ProjectCo structure pairs one permanent development company, which holds a consortium’s origination, studies and know-how, with a separate project company formed for each tender or project.
- [Holding company](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/holding-company.html): A holding company is a company whose main purpose is to own shares in other companies, so that ownership and control sit above the operating businesses.
- [Real-estate fund](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/real-estate-fund.html): A real-estate fund is an investment fund that pools investors’ money to own, develop or finance real estate, under the terms set out in the fund’s documents.
- [Off-balance-sheet vehicle](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/off-balance-sheet-vehicle.html): An off-balance-sheet vehicle is a separate entity that holds assets, and often the financing behind them, outside the sponsor’s own balance sheet, where the accounting rules allow it.
- [Securitization](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/securitization.html): Securitization turns a pool of income-producing assets or receivables into securities that investors can buy, with payments on those securities funded by the pool’s cash flows.
- [Tokenization](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/tokenization.html): Tokenization records rights in an asset, such as ownership or a share of its income, as digital tokens on a digital ledger.
- [Waqf](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/waqf.html): A waqf is an Islamic endowment in which an owner dedicates an asset permanently so that its income goes to the beneficiaries named in the waqf deed.
- [Nazir](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/nazir.html): The nazir is the person or body that administers a waqf, managing its assets, collecting its income and distributing it as the waqf deed requires.

### Real estate and land
- [Musataha](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/musataha.html): Musataha is a right to build on and use land owned by another party for an agreed term, while the landowner keeps title to the land.
- [In-kind contribution](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/in-kind-contribution.html): An in-kind contribution is a non-cash asset, such as land, that a partner contributes to a company in exchange for shares, at an agreed valuation.
- [Concession](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/concession.html): A concession is a contract that gives a party the right to operate an asset or a service for a set term, in return for payments or a share of the revenue.
- [Revenue share](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/revenue-share.html): A revenue share is an agreement under which a party receives an agreed percentage of the revenue an asset or business produces, instead of, or in addition to, a fixed fee or rent.
- [Capital recycling](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/capital-recycling.html): Capital recycling is releasing capital from an asset once it earns, through refinancing or a sale, and reinvesting that capital in the next asset.
- [Mashaer](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/mashaer.html): The Mashaer are the Holy Sites of Mina, Muzdalifah and Arafat, east of Masjid al-Haram in Makkah, through which pilgrims move during Hajj.

### Process and deliverables
- [Deliverable codes](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/deliverable-codes.html): HAYKALAH’s deliverable codes are the short names for the steps of the deliverable chain it has reused for 22 years, from market research to due diligence, each of which answers one question.
- [Model of record](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/model-of-record.html): A model of record is the single financial model that every party to a transaction agrees to use as the reference for its numbers.
- [Data room](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/data-room.html): A data room is a secure, organized store of the documents that investors and lenders review, holding one version of every document.
- [HOAM](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/hoam.html): HOAM, the HAYKALAH Opportunity Assessment Matrix, is HAYKALAH’s tool for scoring a new opportunity on six axes and comparing it with two decades of precedent.
- [Equity-for-build](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/equity-for-build.html): Equity-for-build is a model in which HAYKALAH takes part of its reward as equity in the company or project it builds, vesting at agreed milestones, instead of fees alone.
- [Vesting](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/vesting.html): Vesting is the process by which shares or other rights promised to a person become theirs in stages, as agreed conditions such as time or milestones are met.
- [Shareholders’ agreement](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/shareholders-agreement.html): A shareholders’ agreement is a contract among a company’s shareholders that sets how the company is owned, governed and funded, and how shareholders can enter or leave.

### Regulation and data
- [PDPL](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/pdpl.html): The PDPL is the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law, which sets how personal data may be collected, used, shared and kept, and is overseen by the Saudi Data & AI Authority (SDAIA).
- [PSP Law](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/psp-law.html): The PSP Law is the Saudi Private Sector Participation Law, which sets the rules for public-private partnerships and privatization in the Kingdom.

### Six ways we create value
- [Innovation](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/innovation.html): Innovation is the first of HAYKALAH’s six ways of creating value: designing the structure a deal needs, even when no template exists.
- [Monetization](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/monetization.html): Monetization is the second of HAYKALAH’s six ways of creating value: turning assets that cost money to hold into recurring income and capital.
- [Optimization](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/optimization.html): Optimization is the third of HAYKALAH’s six ways of creating value: testing every option before capital is committed, then choosing the best use, cost and control.
- [Automation](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/automation.html): Automation is the fourth of HAYKALAH’s six ways of creating value: automating reporting, records and routine operations, so that people spend their time on judgment.
- [Transformation](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/transformation.html): Transformation is the fifth of HAYKALAH’s six ways of creating value: changing how an organization, an asset or a portfolio works, from governance to data.
- [Commercialization](https://www.haykalah.com/en/knowledge/commercialization.html): Commercialization is the sixth of HAYKALAH’s six ways of creating value: taking ideas, knowledge and public assets to market with a business model, an operator and paying users.
